title: An AI runs my roguelike dungeon crawler, WIP alpha in your browser, I need your verdict
author: WelcomeMysterious122
selftext:
Very early build where an AI acts as the DM. You pick a character, explore a small grid map, trigger prewritten room events, make choices, and roll a D20 to resolve outcomes. It follows a procedural roguelike approach, but instead of being fully random, each room is semi hand written with set beats. The AI then weaves these events together so they feel more cohesive and connected rather than disconnected random encounters.

Right now it is barebones with one short story, placeholder UI, and light balancing. The aim is to lock in the feel first, then expand with more stories, enemies, events, and progression.

It uses Gemini with free API calls, so if scenes stop generating it probably means I hit the quota for the day. Try again later and it should work.

What I want to know: does map movement feel clear, do the scenes and rolls read quickly, is the UI readable at a glance, and what breaks or feels clunky.

Play here:  [link](https://storyforge-autodm-888660341707.us-west1.run.app/).  A 3 to 5 minute run is enough to see the loop. Brutal honesty helps.
